# IELTS reading score

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/ielts-reading/

Estimate a Reading practice band for IELTS Academic or General Training. Choose the correct test type before entering your raw mark.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Compare 30 correct answers in Academic Reading with 30 in General Training to see why the scales differ.

## Limits and checks

Actual boundaries depend on the test version. General Training usually needs more correct answers for the same band.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
